name: accordo
description: Build a CRM as code you own. Skills that take a coding agent from a business objective to checked-in modules, deterministic workflows, policy-gated approvals, audit and trace, plus the project MCP server whose code-generating tools are dry-run until you pass --apply.

interface.shortDescription: Describe a commercial process; get a CRM as reviewable code you own
interface.longDescription: An open-source framework coding agents use to build custom CRM applications: declarative module manifests that generate migrations, services, a REST API, an SDK and Admin screens; code-first record actions; deterministic workflows with step-level trace; versioned policies; and human approvals an agent cannot make on the user's behalf. The framework has no authentication, tenancy or RBAC, and is local-development-only today.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read AGENTS.md, then run `npm run crm -- app inspect --json` and tell me which parts of my commercial process this project already supports and which it does not
